names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 14335, «Серафим (Василенко), протодиакон, сщмч.», with the rank words left off.

death.note: The year the calendar's day line prints after the eleven names it keeps together: «… мц. Аполлинарии (1937)».

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 30 сентября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. … Серафима диакона …» The day line makes him a deacon; the same site's index of names heads his page «Серафим (Василенко), протодиакон, сщмч.», a protodeacon. The office here follows the index and the disagreement is left standing.

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's own 13 octombrie was not read (2026-10-04); the Romanian calendar does not generally keep the Russian new martyrs.
Not checked: saint.gr/10/13 was not read for him (2026-10-04).
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs's Prologue page for civil 13 October 2026 was not read (2026-10-04).
